entities.name: Damon

entities.name: Stromgald assassin

entities.name: Mirror of Yesterday

events.summary: Damon failed Wane's Mirror of Yesterday test and was told he would never become a wizard.
events.quote: Wane told Damon then that he would never become a wizard.

events.summary: A Stromgald assassin disguised as a healer killed Sabra and Jervis.
events.quote: the healer used an aeolipile to kill her

events.summary: The assassin killed Annarais; Damon tricked the golem into smashing the assassin.
events.quote: Damon then tricked the golem into attacking her

events.summary: Damon realized he was already a wizard.
events.quote: because Damon was already a wizard

relations.quote: Apprenticed to Master Wane of the School of the Unseen
